scientific_scope.primary_prompt: one signed scribble: positive foreground/FN for ADD or negative background/FP for REMOVE, using pinned autoPET V geometry
scientific_scope.bidirectional_prompt_policy: Each method must declare ADD and REMOVE support separately. Unsupported polarity is reported as unsupported; it is never synthesized, dropped from the denominator, or imputed from a full-mask/add-only output.
scientific_scope.warning: External methods are separate spatial comparators. They are not same-weight six-class intent causal arms and must not replace the internal spatial/intent/safety matrix. Any union_with_m0 output is POSITIVE_ONLY_DIAGNOSTIC, never a current primary or bidirectional baseline; legacy positive-only rows are provenance only.

execution_policy.result_truth: No method below has a PET/CT scientific result unless a validated output manifest is produced by a separately authorized execution and shared evaluation. Local imports, checkpoint loads, API smoke checks and unit tests are software evidence only.

network_contract.loss: Paper does not specify loss; the pinned source defaults to DiceCELoss and optionally exposes DiceLoss.
